PreToolUse.description: Block direct edits to main branch

hooks.command: branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then echo '{"block": true, "message": "❌ You are on main. Create a feature branch first: git checkout -b feat/your-feature"}' >&2; exit 2; fi
cmd="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'git add.*\.env\b'; then echo '{"block": true, "message": "❌ Never commit .env — it contains secrets. Use .env.example instead."}' >&2; exit 2; fi
cmd="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^pip install'; then echo '{"block": true, "message": "❌ Use uv instead: uv add <package>"}' >&2; exit 2; fi

PostToolUse.description: Syntax check every Python file after edit

hooks.command: file="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_PATH"; if echo "$file" | grep -q '\.py$'; then uv run python -m py_compile "$file" 2>&1 && echo "✅ Syntax OK: $file" || echo "⚠️ Syntax error in $file — fix before continuing"; fi

PostToolUse.description: Auto-lint with ruff after Python file edits

hooks.command: file="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_PATH"; if echo "$file" | grep -q '\.py$'; then uv run ruff check "$file" --fix --quiet 2>&1 || true; fi
